product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.summary: The 100 MHz Modulo L configuration with an LPX board.
product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.history: Olivetti documented the Modulo P100 L alongside two other Pentium configurations in the Modulo L desktop range.
product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.architect: Memory can grow across three banks. The BA2292 has six SIMM sockets for EDO or Fast Page Mode and a CELP socket for 256 KB of L2 cache.
product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.limitatio: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.service-g: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 9
product.olivetti-modulo-p100-l.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.00.03.CV2 Y.
